title: Add a dark mode toggle
body:
The wall only has a light theme.

**What to do**
- Add a small toggle button next to the search box in `app/src/components/Wall.jsx`.
- Define dark values for the CSS variables in `app/src/app/globals.css` (for example under `[data-theme="dark"]`).
- Remember the choice in `localStorage` (wrap it in `try/catch`).

**Done when** the whole page is readable in both themes and the choice survives a reload.

title: Show a "NEW" badge on cards added in the last 24 hours
body:
Newcomers should be easy to spot.

**What to do**
- In `app/scripts/collect-profiles.mjs`, find when each folder was added (for example with `git log --diff-filter=A --format=%cI -- profiles/<name>`) and store it as `addedAt`.
- In `Wall.jsx`, show a small yellow `NEW` chip on cards whose `addedAt` is within 24 hours of the build.

**Heads up:** Vercel clones with limited history, so fall back gracefully when git history isn't available.

title: Add a sort dropdown: A–Z, Z–A, newest first
body:
Cards are always sorted A–Z.

**What to do**
- Add a `<select>` next to the search box in `Wall.jsx`.
- Sort the visible profiles by the chosen option. "Newest first" can wait until the NEW-badge issue adds `addedAt`, so start with A–Z and Z–A.

**Done when** sorting and search work together.

title: Filter the wall by emoji
body:
Everyone picks an emoji in their `bio.md`. Let's use it.

**What to do**
- Collect the distinct emojis from all profiles in `Wall.jsx`.
- Show them as a row of clickable chips under the search box. Clicking one filters the wall; clicking it again clears the filter.

**Done when** filtering works together with search.

title: Add a "copy profile link" button on profile pages
body:
People want to share their card.

**What to do**
- On `app/src/app/u/[username]/page.jsx`, add a button that copies the page URL with `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.
- It needs to be a client component (`"use client"`). Show "Copied!" for two seconds after clicking.

**Done when** it works on desktop and mobile.

title: Show a random contributor with a "Surprise me" button
body:
A fun way to meet people at the meetup.

**What to do**
- Add a "Surprise me" button on the home page that navigates to a random `/u/<username>` page.

**Done when** repeated clicks visit different people (when there are more than one).

title: Improve the empty-search message
body:
When a search matches nobody, the wall just says "No one matches".

**What to do**
- Add a "Clear search" button inside that message in `Wall.jsx`.
- Bonus: if the search looks like a GitHub username, suggest "Not on the wall yet? Add your card →" linking to `#join`.

title: Add Open Graph image and metadata so shared links look good
body:
Links shared on WhatsApp or LinkedIn show no preview.

**What to do**
- Add `openGraph` metadata in `app/src/app/layout.jsx` and on profile pages (`generateMetadata`).
- Use Next.js `opengraph-image.jsx` (with `ImageResponse`) to render a card with the person's name on the Hacktoberfest background color `#e4e5da`.

**Done when** the preview shows up in a link-preview checker.
